text:
deploy-bot: hold applied: canary failed in staging due to runner volume attach backlog + artifact restore 504s. blocking change window.
mira: saw failing smoke. pod stuck at Init:MountVolume, then timed out.
jon: digging into runner logs — multiple restore retries then EBS attach errors. low-level from kubelet: \"AttachVolume.Attach failed for volume: timeout waiting for attach\"
infra-oncall: checking cloud metrics now. seeing a spike in EBS attach latency in eu-west-1 between 09:05-09:15. also artifact-registry returned a few 504s around 09:12 for blob fetch.
ci-bot: failing job 4901 output:
```
time=\"2026-03-23T09:12:52Z\" level=error msg=\"blob fetch failed\" attempt=3 status=504
time=\"2026-03-23T09:14:10Z\" level=error msg=\"mount timeout after 2m\"
```
release-manager: options? we have a tight change window. manual pin to last-green or wait for infra fix and rerun canary?
mira: given the attach backlog, rerun risks repeated failures. pin to last-green image sha256:3b7c4... and resume promotion. include a note in release notes.
jon: agree. also recommend a short pause on auto-retries for canary jobs to avoid thundering attach attempts.
infra-oncall: we can restart the attach controller and cordon the two most hit nodes, should clear backlog in ~20m. happy to do that after pin.
release-manager: decision: apply manual pin and proceed with promotion to meet change window, then follow-up once infra confirms backlog cleared to re-run canary and unpin if needed.
deploy-bot: applying pin to release v2.7.1 -> image sha256:3b7c4..., suspending canary jobs, proceeding with controlled promote for pinned image. action id: promote-7723456789-1.
ci-bot: manual promote workflow started; smoke checks queued for pinned image.
jon: adding blameless ops note to changelog: \"Canary pinned during change window after transient EBS attach latency spike and artifact registry 504s; infra investigating.\"
infra-oncall: update: attach-controller restarted, two nodes drained and rejoined. attach backlog decreasing. artifact registry 504s stop at 09:20. will watch for 10m and post in #eng-infra.
release-manager: thanks. we'll keep monitor and schedule a rerun canary task for 30-45m post clearance.
mira: adding follow-up ticket linking infra incident and canary rerun.
deploy-bot: release log updated with pin, rationale, and follow-up ticket id: RLS-2026-317.
